spans.s:
The affix उ comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the roots that have taken the Denominative affix क्य in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.'.

Terms: छन्दस्

A feminine word not ending in ऊङ् and having an equivalent and uniform masculine is changed into masculine before the Denominative कयङ् and the affix मानिन्।

Terms: Masculisation

The elision of य of he Denominative अङ्ग (stem) (क्य) is optional when preceded by a consonant and followed by an आर्धधातुक affix.

Terms: आर्धधातुक changes

The य् of a Patronymic affix, preceded by a consonant, is elided before the Denominative affix क्य and the adverbial affix च्वि।

Terms: य elision

Long ई is substituted for the final of अ or आ of a Nominal stem, before the Denominative affix क्यच् ।

Terms: Long ई
